name: Potato Biscuit
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Boil six good-sized potatoes with their jackets on
Take them out with a skimmer, drain and squeeze with a towel to ensure being dry
Remove the skin and mash them perfectly free from lumps
Add a tablespoonful of butter, one egg and a pint of sweet milk
When cool, beat in half a cup of yeast
Put in just enough flour to make a stiff dough
When this rises, make into small cakes
Let them rise the same as biscuit and bake a delicate brown

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Boil six good-sized potatoes with their jackets on
2. Take them out with a skimmer, drain and squeeze with a towel to ensure being dry
3. Remove the skin and mash them perfectly free from lumps
4. Add a tablespoonful of butter, one egg and a pint of sweet milk
5. When cool, beat in half a cup of yeast
6. Put in just enough flour to make a stiff dough
7. When this rises, make into small cakes
8. Let them rise the same as biscuit and bake a delicate brown
